an5.55:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an5.55:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ ubho mātāputtā vassāvāsaṃ upagamiṃsu,
an5.55:1.5: mātā pi puttassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahosi,
an5.55:1.6: putto pi mātaraṃ abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmo ahosi.
an5.55:1.10: Te otiṇṇacittā sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseviṃsu. 2.
an5.55:2.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
an5.55:2.2: Idha bhante Sāvatthiyaṃ ubho mātāputtā vassāvāsaṃ upagamiṃsu,
an5.55:2.3: bhikkhu ca bhikkhunī ca. Te aññamaññassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahesuṃ, mātā pi puttassa abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmā ahosi, putto pi mātaraṃ abhiṇhaṃ dassanakāmo ahosi.
an5.55:2.4: Tesaṃ abhiṇhaṃ dassanā saṃsaggo ahosi, saṃsagge sati vissāso ahosi, vissāse sati otāro ahosi. Te otiṇṇacittā sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseviṃsū ti. 3.
an5.55:3.1: Kin nu so bhikkhave moghapuriso maññati
an5.55:3.2: ‘na mātā putte sārajjati, putto vā pana mātarī' ti?
an5.55:3.3: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekarūpaṃ pi samanupassāmi evaṃ rajanīyaṃ evaṃ kamanīyaṃ evaṃ madanīyaṃ evaṃ bandhanīyaṃ evaṃ mucchanīyaṃ evaṃ antarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthirūpaṃ.
an5.55:3.4: Itthirūpe bhikkhave sattā rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā,
an5.55:4.1: Nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekasaddaṃ pi . . . ekagandhaṃ pi . . . ekarasaṃ pi . . . ekaphoṭṭhabbaṃ pi samanupassāmi evaṃ rajanīyaṃ evaṃ kamanīyaṃ evaṃ madanīyaṃ evaṃ bandhanīyaṃ evaṃ mucchanīyaṃ evaṃ antarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave itthiphoṭṭhabbo.
an5.55:4.2: Itthiphoṭṭhabbe bhikkhave sattā rattā giddhā gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā,
an5.55:5.1: Itthi bhikkhave gacchantī pi purisassa citaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, ṭhitā pi nisinnā pi sayānā pi hasantī pi bhaṇantī pi gāyantī pi rodantī pi ugghātitā pi matā pi purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.
an5.55:5.4: ‘samantapāso Mārassā' ti mātugāmaṃ yeva sammā vadamāno vadeyya
